response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT p.fundflux FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL), per_source AS (SELECT fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM matched GROUP BY fundflux), stats AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM per_source) SELECT ps.fundflux, ps.cnt AS count, ps.cnt::numeric / st.total_cnt AS share, ps.cnt - st.avg_cnt AS exceeds_avg_by FROM per_source ps CROSS JOIN stats st WHERE ps.cnt > st.avg_cnt;

assumptions.assumption: Average count is the unweighted mean of the per-funding-source counts, and the share denominator is the sum of all per-source counts before the above-average filter is applied.
Spatial records whose project has a NULL fundflux are excluded, since NULL is not a funding source. The request does not say how to treat them.
Share is a plain fraction (count / total), not a percentage, and no rounding is applied. The ::numeric cast avoids integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Keep records whose project has a NULL fundflux and treat NULL as its own funding-source group, so it is counted, takes part in the total and average, and can appear in the output.
